gates.explanation: New GoalRunner pause/run-delta and completed Chat accepted/output source must be in the next candidate. Old a035 native reports do not bind them.
The committed new GoalDetail must expose 第 N 轮的正在生成 / 部分输出 / 总结 or 结果 and the actual body. Do not replace Goal with ordinary Task/AssistantTurn.
Actual AX title/description, form grouping, repeated row controls and menu names need bounded exploration against the owned candidate App.

providerUiSafety.reason: QA isolated Keychain rejects keys.delete. Initial blank-key local creation does not write secret; address edits/delete may call keys.delete.
providerUiSafety.modelDiscovery: GET /models only; POST before task must equal zero
providerUiSafety.expectedTieBreak: custom:qa-a before custom:qa-b; verify actual stored attempts, not assumption

limitations: Runner code and static checks alone do not prove native execution; only a passed bound output may support that claim.
A new complete candidate build and Goal partial-output UI surface are mandatory gates.
Normal controlled restart is not a crash/SIGABRT or historical-writer proof.
Both transports are synthetic loopback; no general-provider/network/release/signing/Windows claim.
Accepted Chat checkpoint output is bounded by the existing session field limit; not lossless long-response recovery.
Per-run model-event billing preserves settled calls; old crash calls without a settled result are not retrospectively charged.
If completion rules are uncertain, only real UI explicit user confirmation may close the Goal; report that action separately.
Owned App/process group and verified direct MCP child only; macOS WK XPC process tree is not claimed complete.
Body visibility is measured by the actual PID-bound AX hierarchy, element frames and scroll clipping; no rendered pixel screenshot or general occlusion proof is claimed.

The scenario work deadline is 120 seconds and each AX action is at most 5 seconds. Cleanup grace/kill waits and final hash reads follow it; the frozen cleanup helper uses synchronous ps without an OS command timeout, so a hard total 120-second deadline is not claimed.
